minutes.summary: The commission heard that the back lot expansion bid invitation went out, with work likely in early spring. A vote on the bylaws was put off to the next meeting, and a motion to adjourn was made.

The back lot expansion is the main cemetery capital project, and the bids will show what the work costs and how much of it falls on the town budget, mostly taxes.
